anomalies.observed: On the DISPLAY sheet, the SSD1306 module U4 (ER-OLED0.96-1W) shows its interface-select pins BS0 (pin 10), BS1 (pin 11) and BS2 (pin 12) each wired to the same vertical net that runs down to a GND symbol; there is no separate connection pulling BS1 up to VCC.
anomalies.expected: The spec states the display must be strapped BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0 (BS0 to GND, BS1 to VCC, BS2 to GND) to put the SSD1306 into its I2C interface mode, which is the only mode in which the DISP_SCL/DISP_SDA lines are used.

evidence.quote: That BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0 strapping, together with D0→DISP_SCL and D1+D2 tied together →DISP_SDA, is the SSD1306's documented I2C-mode pin configuration (SCLK on D0, SDA on D1/D2 tied).
U4 (ER-OLED0.96-1W) pins BS0(10), BS1(11), BS2(12) wired together into a common net terminated at GND (DISPLAY sheet)

anomalies.impact: The panel would not be in I2C mode, so the MCU's DISP_SCL/DISP_SDA traffic would never reach the controller and the OLED would stay blank even though the rest of the board (MCU, NFC, touch) works normally.

parsed.summary: Every resistor/capacitor value read off the three sheets matches the specification, so the likely deviation is a connection: on the display sheet the SSD1306's BS0/BS1/BS2 mode-select pins appear tied to a single grounded net instead of the required 0/1/0 strap, which would put the panel in the wrong interface mode and leave it non-functional.
